Battery storage BS-500: frequently asked questions

The BS-500 battery storage system at the Nordhafen site stores up to 500 kWh in lithium iron phosphate modules. This page answers common questions of the operations team.

What does alarm B12 mean?

Alarm B12 means that the cell voltage difference inside one module exceeds 80 mV. The battery management system starts a balancing cycle automatically. If the alarm persists for more than two hours, the module must be inspected.

How often is the fire suppression system tested?

The aerosol fire suppression system is inspected every six months by the certified contractor. The last inspection report was signed by Aylin Demir.
